title: CurveIo
description: The documents of omx_curve_points_json (omx_curve_json.h): a curve request, and its answer, the points of a panel description's display from its role words, the current values and a rate. The JSON form of struct omx_curve_request and of the reply of plugin-hostd's curve_points verb, so the host, the WebAssembly build and the row all speak one shape.

CurveRequest.title: CurveRequest
CurveRequest.description: A curve request: one display of a panel description, already bound to values and a rate (struct omx_curve_request). The request parses no label and reads no descriptor.

family.description: The family that picks the model and, for a transfer curve, the gain computer's mode (CURVE_FAMILIES).

sampleRate.description: The instance's rate, Hz; positive and finite.

points.description: The grid points, 2 to CURVE_POINTS_MAX (an EQ's anchors on top).

terms.description: The terms; a later term of one role and index replaces an earlier.

userOnly.description: Also answer the curve over the user bands alone (and the head filters), at the same x, as userPoints.

tempoBpm.description: The host's tempo, BPM, for a synced delay; absent when the host hands none (a synced delay is then refused as termMissing).

CurveExtents.title: CurveExtents
CurveExtents.description: The x extents: Hz for an EQ, input dB for a transfer curve, ms for a time response; CURVE_EXTENTS when the request gives none.

max.description: The high edge of x, above min.

CurveTerm.title: CurveTerm
CurveTerm.description: One bound term of a curve request: a role of the description, its value now, in its unit (struct omx_curve_term).

role.description: The role word (CURVE_ROLES); a word of none is refused as unitRefused.

index.description: The band's index for an indexed role (band_*); 0 or absent for any other.

unit.description: The unit the description gives the role (CURVE_UNITS); a role takes only the units omx_curve_unit_accepted names.

shape.description: For band_type, the shape its value selects (CURVE_SHAPES, spelt as the description does, the unshaped one as -); for band_freq, the fixed shape of a band no control selects. A word of none is refused as kindUnknown.

origin.description: Where the band comes from (CURVE_ORIGINS): user, the default, or a planter's; a band's is its band_freq term's.

CurvePoint.title: CurvePoint
CurvePoint.description: One point: Hz and dB for an EQ, input dB and output dB for a transfer curve, ms and dB for a reverb's decay.

CurveMark.title: CurveMark
CurveMark.description: A band of an eq_response whose origin is not user: where a surface marks what a corrector plants (struct omx_curve_mark).

depthDb.description: The band's own magnitude at its centre, dB: a bell's gain, a notch's floor.

CurveStem.title: CurveStem
CurveStem.description: One tap of a delay's time_response: where it lands, how loud, how bright, on which leg (struct omx_curve_stem).

x.description: The tap's time, ms from the impulse.

y.description: Its level, dB relative to the impulse.

CurveReply.title: CurveReply
CurveReply.description: A curve: the points ascending in x, the marks of the bands a corrector planted and, when the request asks or the display has them, the user-only curve and a delay's stems.

points.description: The points, ascending in x; none for a delay, whose train is the stems.

marks.description: One per drawn band whose origin is not user, in band order; none for a transfer curve.

userPoints.description: With userOnly: the curve over the user bands and the head filters alone, at the same x.

stems.description: A delay's tap train, in time order; absent for every other display.

CurveRefusal.title: CurveRefusal
CurveRefusal.description: What the answer is when no curve is drawn: the code of CURVE_CODES other than ok. No curve is drawn from a guess.

code.description: What is missing or refused: kindUnknown, termMissing, unitRefused, valueNotFinite, pointsRange or room.
